# ISuperstateStandardArkErrors
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/errors/arks/ISuperstateStandardArkErrors.sol)

**Title:**
ISuperstateStandardArkErrors

Custom errors raised by the Superstate standard Ark contract


## Errors
### InvalidDepositAddress
Thrown when the configured deposit address is the zero address.


```solidity
error InvalidDepositAddress();
```

### InsufficientPendingDeposit
Thrown when an operation references more pending-deposit assets than are actually pending.


```solidity
error InsufficientPendingDeposit();
```

### PendingDepositActive
Thrown when an operation is attempted while a deposit cycle is already in flight.


```solidity
error PendingDepositActive();
```

### ArkIsFrozen
Thrown when an operation is attempted while the Ark is frozen.


```solidity
error ArkIsFrozen();
```

### NotAllowlisted
Reserved; not reverted by the Ark — allowlist enforcement is performed by the external Superstate
token during redemption, not via this error.


```solidity
error NotAllowlisted();
```

### InsufficientYield
Reserved; not currently reverted anywhere in the Ark.


```solidity
error InsufficientYield();
```
